concept.title: Interface Overview
concept.shortdesc: A tour of the main OBS Studio window and where each panel lives.

conbody.p: The default OBS Studio layout has five main areas: the Preview pane showing your current scene, the Scenes list, the Sources list for the selected scene, the Audio Mixer, and the Controls panel with Start Recording/Streaming buttons.

ul.li: Scenes panel — every saved scene in the current scene collection.
Sources panel — the sources that make up whichever scene is selected.
Audio Mixer — a volume fader and mute button per audio source.
Controls — Start/Stop Streaming, Start/Stop Recording, Settings, Exit.

conbody.p: Panels can be undocked, resized, or hidden from the Docks menu, and the whole layout can be saved and restored independently per scene collection.
